bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹至 5 日均线

read.en: Coherent rose 5.8% on Oct 26 to $221.50, trading between $208.86 and $225.66. It is at the falling 5-day ($221.6) and below the falling 10-day ($237.7), 30-day ($283.3) and 100-day ($311.6) averages and the rising 200-day ($295.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($264.24), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: Coherent 10月26日上涨 5.8%，收于 $221.50，盘中区间 $208.86–225.66。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$221.6）附近，低于下行的 10 日（$237.7）、30 日（$283.3）和 100 日均线（$311.6）以及上行的 200 日均线（$295.6）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$264.24），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The rebound cleared $215.4 and the $217.8–220.7 resistance (Oct 20 and Jul 29 lows), now support, and closed at the 5-day. Resistance is $221.6–225.7 (5-day, Oct 26 high), then $231.6–231.8 (Oct 16 and 19 lows) and $237.7 (10-day). Support is $217.8–220.7, then $208.9 (Oct 26 low) and $203.6–204.6. A close above $225.7 would target $231.6–237.7; a close below $217.8 would reopen $204–209.

s.en: Oct 22 and Oct 23 lows ($203.6–204.4); Feb 17 low $204.6
